description: Return one order of the current customer

decisions.question: What does it do, step by step (read, check, change, save, call)?
decisions.answer: Find the order; check it belongs to the customer; return it

decisions.question: Something it needs does not exist: which domain error?
decisions.answer: OrderNotFoundError - also when it belongs to someone else, so ids reveal nothing

decisions.question: Called twice with the same input (a client retry): same result and no duplicate effect (idempotent), or a duplicate error?
Who may perform it, and is that checked here or in the router?
What must be all or nothing (one transaction), and what happens if a call to another service fails in the middle?
decisions.answer: Nothing to undo: it only reads

safety.question: A dependency down or slow, or the resource does not exist: what must never happen?

suggestion.hazard: a request fails badly when a dependency is down or the resource does not exist
suggestion.invariant: OrderNotFoundError - also when it belongs to someone else, so ids reveal nothing (decision 2)

decision.answer: OrderNotFoundError - also when it belongs to someone else, so ids reveal nothing

safety.question: Sent twice (a client retries or submits twice): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: Reads only: repeating it, stopping it halfway or running it twice at once changes nothing

safety.question: A change half applied (saved here, not there; a failure mid-transaction): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: Reads only: repeating it, stopping it halfway or running it twice at once changes nothing

safety.question: Two requests change the same data at the same time (lost update, negative stock): what must never happen?
safety.dismissed: Reads only: repeating it, stopping it halfway or running it twice at once changes nothing

safety.question: Data exposed (a user sees or changes data that is not theirs; secrets or personal data in a response or a log): what must never happen?

suggestion.hazard: a user sees or changes data that is not theirs, or a secret leaks
